entities.name: UniProt Q32ZH5
observations: Exact 65-aa sequence match to reviewed Rattus norvegicus beta-defensin 17; reported antibacterial activity and secretion.
UniProt-linked annotations include defense response to bacterium, innate immune response, cell chemotaxis, CCR6 binding, and extracellular region.
Pfam scan detects Defensin_beta_2 (PF13841.12) at residues 34–64.
